lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li4Ga2Co2O8 (reduced formula Li2GaCoO4) crystallizes in the trigonal R-3m space group (No. 166), with 16 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Ga and Co centers each coordinated by four O neighbors, while Li centers show six O neighbors and O centers show five neighbors (Ga, Co, Li). The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows O-centered 5-vertex polyhedra connected through corner- and edge-sharing, with Li-centered 6-vertex polyhedra sharing edges and faces.
